coreValidation.qualification: Historical core suite; new independent public-formula checks are separately attributed.

design.unit: same deck pair, seed and family; first-player crossed with candidate seat
design.primaryExclusion: Exclude an entire four-game unit if missing, non-victory or anomalous; separately report all natural rows and reasons.

main.resampling: Within each family, resample complete clean four-game unitIds with replacement; sample the same count of units per replicate. Sort units by unitId before sampling.
main.aggregate: Only pooled descriptive point estimates; no aggregate interval and never treat all 384 games as independent.
main.smallN: Single-unit percentile intervals are explicitly marked degenerate; zero clean units return no interval.

anchor.resampling: Within each family, resample complete clean four-game unitIds with replacement; sample the same count of units per replicate. Sort units by unitId before sampling.
anchor.aggregate: Only pooled descriptive point estimates; no aggregate interval and never treat all 384 games as independent.
anchor.smallN: Single-unit percentile intervals are explicitly marked degenerate; zero clean units return no interval.

analysisScopeMetadataDiscrepancies.authority: The precommitted design game specifications and result/spec hashes determine executed seeds and stage counts. The plan scope metadata is stale; it is retained and disclosed, not rewritten after results.
analysisScopeMetadataDiscrepancies.effectOnExecutedGameSelection: No alteration: analysis verifies the design and bound result/spec hashes; this disclosure corrects descriptive scope metadata only.

bootstrap.resamplingUnit: complete clean unitId, all four games together
bootstrap.interpretation: Conditional uncertainty among these fixed deck-pair/seed units; not a population or independent-game interval

notes: Worker elapsed sums overlap across workers and are not run wall-clock time.
Worker elapsed includes engine, instrumentation and any display probe; policy timings measure original policy calls only.
Action counts and selected/opportunity counts are descriptive, not causal quality or win-rate evidence.
Completed-turn action rates exclude the unfinished final turn; latency quantiles are histogram bounds, not exact quantiles.

limitations: Fixed 12-deck sample with repeated seeds; not a population or human/server win-rate estimate.
Decks recur across pairs; four-game bootstrap is a conditional summary, not independent deck sampling.
All final comparison seeds were used by candidate02; no entirely unseen final holdout is claimed.
Combined implementation changes are evaluated without causal ablation of individual fixes.
Missing public history, event context or unsupported continuations remain explicitly uncertain.
No new Elo rating, deployment or online acceptance is claimed.
